summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright integration checks for navigation, planner AI flow, tasks, focus logging, deadlines/reminders, and analytics updates.

issues: Date fields use browser-native date picker (type='date') instead of a consistent app calendar component (e.g., shadcn calendar).

action_items: Optional UX refinement: replace native date inputs with consistent calendar UI component for cross-browser consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: No backend critical defects found in tested endpoints; CRUD persistence and analytics aggregation behaved correctly.
Frontend route wiring, API integration hooks, and state refresh logic are working in tested flows.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_/PW_ entities during tests; task/deadline test entities were deleted. Focus sessions/plans persist due no delete endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary flows validated successfully against public URL. One initial Playwright selector attempt failed due dynamic data-testid prefix matching child nodes; resolved via stricter index discovery.
rca of the issue: Initial UI script failure RCA: selector [data-testid^='task-item-'] matched row children (title/meta/buttons), causing invalid index references and timeout. Mitigation: identify indices only from exact row testid pattern /^task-item-\d+$/.
